facts.business: Sonal Mercantile Limited is an NBFC engaged in providing loans and advances (inter-corporate, personal, trade financing, bill discounting, project appraisal, loans against guarantee and properties) and trading in shares, securities, and arbitrage in stock and commodity markets.

segments.name: Single reportable segment (Loans & Advances and Investment in Securities)

auditor.name: M/s. Ajay Rattan & Co. Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Competition from new systematically important NBFCs and existing local/multinational players
